title: Bonus: Why the Enrolled Agent and Series 65 Exams Are Worth It
desc: Money, freedom and demand: what the Enrolled Agent credential and the Series 65 license unlock. Enrolled Agents get unlimited rights to represent taxpayers before the IRS, no degree required. NATP 2025 Fee Study: average hourly rate $182, half charge $129–$250. BLS: personal financial advisors median pay $102,140 (May 2024), top 10% above $357,020, jobs projected +10% 2024–2034. National figures, not promises. Free study apps with quizzes and mock exams: https://solvinglifellc.com/apps (first hour free).
